classification.difficultyReason: Match opposite side–angle pairs and apply the sine rule, using exact standard-angle values in (a); in (b), first find the missing angle from the triangle angle sum, then calculate and round the side.

content.prompt: Find the unknowns in each diagram. Give an exact answer in (a). In (b), give $\beta$ exactly and $x$ correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Horizontal-base triangle with left base angle 45°, right base angle 30°, left sloping side x and right sloping side 10. Ordinary lines and labels are black; no shading.
spec.mathematics: The side x is opposite 30°; the side 10 is opposite 45°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x are visible.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal base 8, apex angle 60°, right base angle 70°, left base angle beta and right sloping side x. Unshaded black geometry.
spec.mathematics: The base 8 is opposite 60°; x is opposite beta.
spec.answerVisibility: The diagram retains beta and x as unknowns.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\beta&=180^\circ-60^\circ-70^\circ\\\beta&=50^\circ\end{align*}$$
By the sine rule,
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{\sin50^\circ}&=\frac{8}{\sin60^\circ}\\x&=\frac{8\sin50^\circ}{\sin60^\circ}\\x&\approx7.08\end{align*}$$
Thus $x=7.08$ correct to 2 decimal places.
